# Healthcare Professionals

This folder contains profiles of the clinical professionals who serve on the steering committee (styregruppe) for the Acute Surgery Database (Akut Kirurgi Databasen), alongside a conceptual page on the role of the anaestesiologist in acute care. The individuals listed represent a cross-regional and interdisciplinary mix of surgeons, anesthesiologists, nurses, and physiotherapists who govern clinical quality indicators and operational frameworks for acute surgery across Denmark's five regions. Each page details their hospital affiliations, professional society representations, and specific contributions to the database's governance under the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP).

## Pages

- [[anaestesiolog|anæstesiolog]] — The role of the anaestesiologist in pre-optimizing acute surgical patients and associated coding uncertainties with SKS code NAAZ42.
- [[camilla-leidcker|Camilla Leidcker]] — Clinical development nurse at Hvidovre Hospital representing gastroenterological nurses on the AKDB steering committee.
- [[halfdan-lauridsen|Halfdan Lauridsen]] — Leading consultant physician at Nordsjællands Hospital representing the Danish Society for Emergency Medicine on the AKDB steering committee.
- [[jakob-burcharth|Jakob Burcharth]] — Department physician at Herlev and Gentofte Hospital representing the Danish Society for Clinical Nutrition on the AKDB steering committee.
- [[karen-vestergaard-andersen|Karen Vestergaard Andersen]] — Clinical nurse specialist at Aarhus University Hospital representing the Danish Nursing Society on the AKDB steering committee.
- [[kristian-aagaard-poulsen|Kristian Aagaard Poulsen]] — Consultant physician at Odense University Hospital representing the Danish Surgical Society on the AKDB steering committee.
- [[line-rokkedal-jonsson|Line Rokkedal Jønsson]] — Development physiotherapist at Amager and Hvidovre Hospital representing the Danish Society for Physiotherapy on the AKDB steering committee.
- [[marianne-vinbaek|Marianne Vinbæk]] — Chief Physician at Aalborg University Hospital representing the Danish Surgical Society on the AKDB steering committee.
- [[nicolai-bang-foss|Nicolai Bang Foss]] — Clinical professor and chief physician at Amager and Hvidovre Hospital representing the Danish Society of Anaesthesiology and Intensive Care Medicine on the AKDB steering committee.
- [[rasmus-haarup-lie|Rasmus Haarup Lie]] — Anesthesiologist at Aarhus University Hospital representing the Danish Society of Anaesthesiology and Intensive Care Medicine on the AKDB steering committee.
- [[rikke-therkildsen|Rikke Therkildsen]] — Consultant physician at Aarhus University Hospital representing the Danish Surgical Society on the AKDB steering committee.
- [[rune-trangbaek|Rune Trangbæk]] — Medical doctor and evidence specialist at Zealand University Hospital representing the Danish Surgical Society on the AKDB steering committee.
- [[thomas-jorgensen|Thomas Jørgensen]] — Function-responsible consultant physician at Zealand University Hospital representing the Danish Surgical Society on the AKDB steering committee.
